front.title: YANG Groupings for QUIC clients and QUIC servers

abstract.t: This document defines three YANG 1.1 modules to support the configuration of QUIC clients and QUIC servers. The common YANG module defines reusable groupings for setting parameters imported from the QUIC version and QUIC transport IANA YANG modules. The two QUIC client and server YANG modules define reusable groupings for QUIC connection settings, including the common QUIC parameters, for protocol implementation. Furthermore two initial YANG 1.1 modules for the IANA registries "QUIC Versions" and "QUIC Transport Parameters" are included in Appendix.
